Entity.name: (Extremely) high liquidity and credit quality indicator
Entity.commentInRDBMS: (Extremely) high liquidity and credit quality indicator identifies assets that are of high liquidity and credit quality and that therefore are listed in Articles 10, 11, 12 and 13 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/61 and would comply with the general and operational requirements set out in Articles 7 and 8 of that Delegated Regulation.

Attribute.name: (Extremely) high liquidity and credit quality indicator
Attribute.comment: An indicator specifying if an asset or collateral received is considered extremely high liquidity and credit quality (HQLA) eligible according to Regulation (EU) 680/2014, Annex 17 (Asset encumbrance), part 2, 2.1.2, column 035.

identifier.name: High liquidity and credit quality (HQLA) type PK
